messages.author: a4c5d7d1c977b688
messages.subject: fail to install nimbleHMC
parts:
Hi team,

I'm trying to install the latest version of nimble and nimbleHMC package so that I can use the NUTS samplers. I successfully did it on my personal computer but not my work computer. For my personal computer, R 4.2.2 is installed in the default Program Files folder, but for my work computer, R 4.1.2 is installed in a different folder due to administration constraints. I wonder if it's the version or the path of R (or something else) that causes the problem. I can successfully use nimble on both.

When I tried to install nimbleHMC on my work computer, I got the following error message (among other things):

*** arch - i386
Error : package 'nimble' is not installed for 'arch = i386'
Error: loading failed
Execution halted
*** arch - x64
ERROR: loading failed for 'i386'

Please advice. Thank you.

Best,
Qing

messages.author: d78486bfff620d81
messages.subject: Re: fail to install nimbleHMC

-chris

messages.subject: Re: fail to install nimbleHMC
parts:
hi Qing,

I don't think the place where you install them matters.

R 4.1.2 is pretty old, so if you can update to the current version of R and Rtools and then reinstall nimble and nimbleHMC, that is worth trying, though I don't have any specific reason to think that would fix the issue.

But it's worth trying.

If things still don't work, please install `nimbleHMC` again on your personal computer and show me the output you get from doing that so we can compare it
to what you get on your work computer when installing `nimbleHMC`.

-chris
